title: The Disposable Classes: How the Empire Uses War and Exploitation to Maintain Control
summary: We analyze the systematic use of disposable populations by the empire — the poor, the vulnerable, the stateless — as fuel for two parallel machines of destruction: war and sexual exploitation. In Yemen, cheap labor and disposable lives are fed into endless conflict, serving Petro dollar interests. In the Epstein network, vulnerable girls are fed into a system of blackmail, extortion, and kidnapping, serving the same empire. This is a designed system — a dual-machine that consumes the poor and the powerless to maintain control. We conclude that the empire operates using a shared protocol —…

review.reason: Polemical analysis of war, exploitation, and power that links several contested topics.
